feature: Diplomat dan VIP vehicle diproses langsung ke RD1 setelah respons LTA
note: Setelah respons LTA, kendaraan diplomat (diplomaticFlag y, vehicle_registration_type D) dan VIP (V) tidak lewat exclusion list/DataHive: owner di-update lalu stage langsung RD1. Bukan bagian OCMS7.1-7.5; belum jelas story mana yang menaunginya.
note_en: After the LTA response, diplomat (diplomaticFlag y, vehicle_registration_type D) and VIP (V) vehicles skip the exclusion list/DataHive: the owner is updated and the stage goes straight to RD1. Not part of OCMS7.1-7.5; it is unclear which story covers it.

feature: Pencarian kontak (mobile/email) via DataHive dan stage ENA setelah respons LTA sukses
note: Untuk error code 0, owner non-passport dicari kontaknya di DataHive; bila ada kontak, notice ke ENA, bila tidak ke RD1, dan laporan Datahive Contact Info dibuat setelah LTA download. Tidak disebut di story OCMS7.1-7.5.
note_en: For error code 0, non-passport owners are looked up in DataHive for contact details; with contact the notice goes to ENA, otherwise RD1, and a Datahive Contact Info report is generated after the LTA download. Not mentioned in OCMS7.1-7.5.

feature: Daftar eksklusi e-notification dan owner passport memaksa stage RD1 setelah respons LTA
note: Owner yang ada di ocms_enotification_exclusion_list atau ber-ID passport (LTA type 2/3) langsung ke RD1 tanpa pencarian kontak. Bukan bagian OCMS7.1-7.5.
note_en: Owners in ocms_enotification_exclusion_list or with passport IDs (LTA type 2/3) go straight to RD1 without a contact lookup. Not part of OCMS7.1-7.5.
